issues.title: Palestine: Security Alert After Suspected Ramming Attempt in Jordan Valley
issues.title_en: Palestine: Security Alert After Suspected Ramming Attempt in Jordan Valley
issues.summary: Israeli media reported on Saturday that a suspected ramming attempt took place near a military training base in the Jordan Valley in the occupied West Bank. Israeli forces opened fire and closed the area following the incident.
